args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Lightweight shorts and t-shirts
- Sundresses or skirts
- Pants or long-sleeve shirts for cooler evenings
- Light jacket or sweater
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Hat and sunglasses

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburn relief)
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash or soap
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Hairdryer (if needed)
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Skincare products
- Insect repellent

Accessories:
- Beach bag or tote
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (if planning to snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Waterproof dry bag for electronics
- Camera (optional)

Documents and Essentials:
- Passport or ID
- Travel tickets or reservations
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel or accommodation reservations
- Itinerary or vacation plans
- Emergency contact information

Miscellaneous:
- Beach towel
- Waterproof sunscreen
- Waterproof watch or fitness tracker
- Books or e-reader
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Power bank or portable charger
- Waterproof backpack or day bag
- Waterproof shoes or sandals
- Waterproof sunscreen
- Waterproof watch or fitness tracker
- Books or e-reader
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Power bank or portable charger
